7.2.4.11.6 Rte_Rips_NotifyRxIndication
[SWS_Rte_05303] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndica-
tion_<CGI> ⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndication_<CGI>
Syntax
void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndication_<CGI> (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0105
Sync/Async
Synchronous
▽
△
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API
Parameters (in)
PduInfoPtr
Contains the length (SduLength) of the received PDU, a pointer
to a buffer (SduDataPtr) containing the PDU, and the MetaData
related to this PDU.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Rte_Rips_NotifyRxIndication notifies the RTE Implementation Plug-In that the LdCom signal
used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation is ready for reception. This
function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom_IF Rte_LdComCbkRxIndication
callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00123] for more details on the functionality of this
callback.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
⌋

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317

provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyRxIndication_<CGI> Service for each
